exposure: History of cesarean section in a primary healthcare hospital
Time from previous cesarean section to CSP
High-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) combined with hysteroscopy
outcome: Number of days with abdominal pain
Number of days with vaginal bleeding
Time for b-hCG levels to return to normal
cohort: This study included 140 patients from a cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) cohort.
finding: HIFU combined with hysteroscopy was identified as an independent protective factor against non-textbook outcomes in patients with cesarean scar pregnancy, while a history of cesarean section at a primary hospital, CSP-III classification, and intraoperative blood loss exceeding 30 mL were independent risk factors for adverse outcomes.
